tpl.exec_lead: A short summary of the open-source check: how serious the problems are, what was found and what to do first.
tpl.comp_lead: Findings are mapped to MITRE ATT&CK v20, CWE (flagging the 2025 CWE Top 25), OWASP Top 10:2025, OWASP WSTG v4.2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (ДСТУ ISO/IEC 27001:2023), NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 / НД ТЗІ 3.6-006-24 measures, GDPR and Law of Ukraine No. 2297-VI "On Personal Data Protection" articles for findings with personal data and, for systems certified under КСЗІ, to the functional services of НД ТЗІ 2.5-004-99 and the КСЗІ creation stages of НД ТЗІ 3.7-003-05.
tpl.comp_ndtzi: НД ТЗІ 2.5-004-99 functional services (for systems certified under КСЗІ)
tpl.comp_kszi: КСЗІ creation work, НД ТЗІ 3.7-003-05 (for systems certified under КСЗІ)
tpl.comp_nist: НД ТЗІ 3.6-006-24 / NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 security measures
tpl.comp_legacy: НД ТЗІ 2.5-004-99 and НД ТЗІ 3.7-003-05 are given for systems certified under КСЗІ. НД ТЗІ 3.6-006-24 measure codes are the NIST SP 800-53 codes.
tpl.lab_goal_text: Study open sources about «{0}» with OSINT methods: collect published documents, extract metadata, find information leaks and map the findings to information security standards.
tpl.lab_limits_text: Only publicly available data and the provided files were used, with no attempt to bypass protection. The conclusions reflect the state of the sources on the study date.
tpl.lab_stage_meta: Metadata extraction: people {0}, e-mail addresses {1}, hosts {2}, software {3}.
tpl.lab_stage_analysis: Analysis: findings {0} (critical {1}, high {2}, medium {3}, low {4}, info {5}).
groups: Passwords or access keys are publicly available: anyone can use them.
Change the exposed passwords and keys immediately and remove the files from the site.
Published files still contain what was believed to be deleted or blacked out.
Clean documents before publishing: tracked changes, hidden sheets, blacked-out text, metadata.
A signed document was changed after signing: its authenticity cannot be confirmed.
Re-sign the documents and publish only final signed versions.
Personal data of employees or customers is published.
Remove personal data from public files and check the legal basis for processing it.
Files reveal the internal network: computer and server names, paths.
Remove internal paths, computer and server names from documents before publishing.
Outdated software with known vulnerabilities is in use.
Update the outdated software and set up regular updates.
The secure connection to the site is weakly configured.
Harden the site's TLS and certificate settings and enable HSTS.
The site or cloud storage is configured insecurely.
Close unneeded files and services of the site and cloud storage, fix the security headers.
A security problem that needs attention was found.
Work through the remaining findings by priority and fix them.
generic_actions: Train staff to remove metadata before publishing documents.
Repeat the check after the fixes and keep running it regularly.
